name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on multilateral negotiations in view of the WTO’s 14th Ministerial Conference in Yaoundé, 26 to 29 March 2026
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants from the World Trade Organization's meeting in Yaoundé, Cameroon, on 26–29 March 2026. It asks members to modernise the WTO: fix its stalled dispute settlement system, tighten rules on industrial subsidies, renew the ban on customs duties for electronic transmissions, and reach a deal on fisheries subsidies. It also wants developing countries' special treatment reviewed and a bigger role for parliaments. This is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks WTO members to agree reforms at the March 2026 meeting.
- **Who it affects:** WTO members, businesses trading across borders, fishing industries and developing countries.
- **What happens next:** Talks in Yaoundé; Parliament wants a reform roadmap agreed there, with reforms settled at the next conference.
